modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: On Normal difficulty, characters on the regular difficulty buff use the Hard level instead: more HP, knockdown resistance, faster attacks and movement. Bosses and mini-bosses stay at Normal, as does the player. Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Field-name (V3) mod: DMM locates each field itself, so it survives game updates that move data.
modinfo.title: CD Hard Enemies, Normal Bosses
